text:
The combination of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face, sensory changes in the palms, and specifically the loss of eyebrow and eyelash hairs is highly suggestive of a parasitic infection. Given your occupation working with livestock and rice farming, this presentation is classic for scabies infestation, particularly the crusted form which can cause sensory neuropathy.
